headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: August 14, 2026**
article:
The St. Louis Cardinals suffered a 3-0 shutout loss to the Chicago Cubs, while the Cincinnati Reds secured a narrow 1-0 victory over the Miami Marlins. The Pittsburgh Pirates took down the Boston Red Sox 8-4, and the Chicago White Sox dominated the Detroit Tigers 9-5.

Injuries and availability continue to impact teams, with several players landing on the injured list. Vladimir Guerrero Jr. has been placed on the 7-day injured list due to a concussion, joining Abner Uribe (right forearm flexor strain), Colt Emerson (left wrist tendon inflammation), Davis Martin (right middle finger blister), Matt Chapman (abdominal strain), Trevor McDonald (right elbow strain), Garrett Whitlock (right elbow inflammation), and James Outman (concussion) on the injured list.

Several trades and roster moves have taken place, including Harold Rivas being traded to the Baltimore Orioles as part of a deal involving the Boston Red Sox. The Kansas City Royals also acquired Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Fall to Cubs in 3-0 Shutout**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals suffered a 3-0 loss to the Chicago Cubs, with the Cubs' pitching staff shutting out the Cardinals.

top_news.title: **Reds Take Down Marlins in Thrilling 1-0 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds secured a narrow win over the Miami Marlins, with Chase Burns pitching a strong 7.0 innings, striking out 8 and allowing 0 earned runs. Eugenio Suárez led the Reds' offense with a double that scored the game's only run.

top_news.title: **Pirates Take Down Red Sox 8-4**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a convincing 8-4 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Bubba Chandler earning the win after 5.0 innings of work. Rafael Flores Jr. led the Red Sox offense with 3 hits, including a home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **White Sox Take Down Tigers 9-5**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox secured a 9-5 victory over the Detroit Tigers, led by a dominant performance from their offense. Miguel Vargas led the charge with 4 hits, 2 home runs, and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Vladimir Guerrero Jr. Lands on 7-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Toronto Blue Jays first baseman Vladimir Guerrero Jr. has been placed on the 7-day injured list due to a concussion.

top_news.title: **Rivas Joins Orioles in Trade**
top_news.summary: Harold Rivas has been traded to the Baltimore Orioles as part of a deal involving the Boston Red Sox. The trade is related to the August 3 Adley Rutschman trade.
